# HEM v0.8.3

The room trend chart now draws measured values, controller targets, PID demand and reported output as solid lines. Each series has its own color, including both limits of a target range. Legend swatches identify the controller and match its lines and isolated samples.

Changes in target and output remain steps at their recorded times. Missing or interrupted observations leave gaps. The left scale shows the measured quantity and the right scale shows output percentage or device activity.
